column1: # Full-stack words (depth/pick/roll) — the P1.2 capability target
# SURVEY.0.md §3a). Deliberately off-corpus until now: a full-stack word's
# result has no producing event the compiler can address, so the whole
# program refuses ("residual value of unknown provenance") and falls back.
# The survey ranks this the only remaining class whose fix ADDS capability
# (an event-producing lowering minting runtime provenance — OpDepth/OpPick/
# OpRoll) rather than relaxing a soundness gate. Graduation = that lowering;
# the ledger entries then delete and the rows move to the main corpus.

column3: depth reports the stack size and leaves the stack intact
pick copies the value at depth n (0 = top) onto the top
roll rotates the value at depth n to the top
a full-stack result consumed by a downstream dispatch
